description: Describes the Valuein SEC data warehouse. With no arguments it lists every table with a one-line description and its column count; pass `table` (e.g. 'fact') for that table's columns, types, primary keys and foreign-key references. Use this tool to understand the data model before querying with other tools. No data reads required — schema is embedded in the manifest. Available on all plans.

table.description: A single table name (e.g. 'fact', 'entity', 'references') to return its full column definitions. Omit to list every table with a one-line description and column count.

name: describe_schema

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

columns.description: Single-table mode: map of column name → definition

note.description: Table-list mode: how to get one table's columns

schema_version.description: Parquet schema version from the active R2 manifest

table.description: Single-table mode: the requested table name

tables.description: Table-list mode: map of table name → { description (its first sentence), column_count }

title: Describe Data Schema
